test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in indirect speech.

“I am going to play with my friends,” the child says to his mother.

options.text: The child tells his mother that he is going to play with his friends.
The child asked his mother that he is going to play with his friends.
The child told his mother that I am going to play with my friends.
The child said to his mother that he was going to play with his friends.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The child tells his mother that he is going to play with his friends.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
